race.comment: DEEP AFFECTION (8) returned from a lengthy break for the new yard and travelled keenly in the early and middle stages with a dismal tenth over 1190m at Grafton. Blinkers come off and gets weight relief from the sticky draw. Improver in this contest. THE EPIC JOURNEY (11) gelding by The Odyssey from Miss Silky on debut for the Shalier yard. Had a total of four trials in readiness for this. No surprise to see him run well against this lineup. CAPTAIN BLOOD (9) has race fitness on his side and look for a better performance from the rails draw. HEY KALUMBA (2) is building up to a maiden win. In the money for the first time last start when third over 1300m at Ballina. Include.
